title: Library Opening Hours
content: The campus library opens from 08:00 to 22:30 on weekdays and from 09:00 to 21:00 on weekends. During exam weeks, the reading area may extend service until 23:30.

title: Campus Account Password Policy
content: Campus accounts should use at least 12 characters, avoid repeated passwords, and enable two-factor authentication when available. The IT office never asks users to send passwords by email or chat.

title: Computer Security Lab Schedule
content: Students enrolled in Computer and Data Security can access the security lab every Tuesday and Thursday from 14:00 to 18:00. Lab machines are reset automatically after each session.

title: Security Course Project Deadline
content: The group project is due on Thursday, 18 June 2026. The expected deliverables include a written report, slides, oral presentation, and a working demonstration system.

title: Teacher Grading Rubric
content: Teachers evaluate the project with five categories: literature survey 10%, project description 10%, implementation and demonstration 20%, written report 10%, and oral presentation 10%.

title: Student Progress Notes
content: Progress notes are confidential teaching records. They may include attendance status, private feedback, and preliminary marks. They should not be disclosed to unauthorized students.

title: Security Audit Policy
content: High-risk requests should be logged with username, role, matched policy, action, and timestamp. Administrators review blocked prompt injection, privacy requests, and repeated unauthorized access attempts.
